moments.text: Infrared sensor view with dark circular shading and light cloud along the top. A small white spot sits just below and right of the crosshair.
The picture flashes white, then black, then flat grey for about half a second.
The image returns with vertical stripes; the white spot, right of the crosshair, slides left across the view.
Against plain grey sky the spot swings up from the left of the crosshair and across the top of the view to the upper right.
Bright cloud sweeps in from the left and bottom; the spot sits above and right of the crosshair at the cloud edge.
A layer of light and dark cloud fills the view; the spot stays near the crosshair, drifting from its right side to its upper left.
The spot moves to the right of the crosshair, then settles just below it until the end.
